claims.claim: DIAMOND aligns proteins 100 to 10,000 times faster than BLAST
claims.kill: DIAMOND's CPU-hours per 1,000 queries are more than 1/100 of BLASTP's, on the same queries, relatives and machine
claims.scope: The 998 human queries against the 15 relatives, both tools run by the host on Sherlock with their traces. Needs DIAMOND rows (the DIAMOND module, branch olgabot/annotator-tools) and a BLASTP module, which this site does not have yet.
claims.verdict: DIAMOND and BLASTP have not been run on the QfO relatives

author_claim.quote: Pairwise alignment of proteins and translated DNA at 100x-10,000x speed of BLAST.
